title: Licence audit for the desktop release
context: The full audit is notes/licenses.md (#424). Code, fonts, RDBT pictures, Qwen3-TTS voices and Stable Audio ambience are fine to ship with credits. Every voice in the game is synthetic; no real person's recording is used.

Two things block selling the game, though a free release is fine for them: the opening theme and the night loop are YuE2 music (the model is CC BY-NC 4.0, and whether that reaches the music is unsettled), and the five Photos collectibles and some scenery come from One Obsession, whose Civitai page doesn't allow selling images.

The audit also found 36 old clips made with edge-tts, an unofficial Microsoft service with no licence. The game no longer plays them; they were retired today and the release leaves them out, so nothing to decide there.
Still unclear: the MiniMax-derived voice references (Emi, the announcer), Lyria's output terms, and about 121 older clips whose engine wasn't recorded.
question: Will the desktop release be free or paid, and which fixes should I start now?

options.label: free
options.note: Free release. Keep the YuE2 tracks and One Obsession pictures, ship with the drafted credits.

options.label: paid
options.note: Make it sellable: replace the opening theme and night loop with Lyria, regenerate the Photos and scenery with RDBT, settle the unclear items.

options.label: remake-minimax
options.note: Re-make Emi's and the announcer's voice references with Qwen3 VoiceDesign so nothing depends on MiniMax's terms. Changes how they sound, so it comes back to you as a voice round.

ask: Pick free or paid, plus any fixes to start. In the comment: was the Meshy account on a paid plan when the 3D models were made (free-plan models need a Meshy credit line)?
decision: free now; paid later: "for later, list out what needs remaking"; "explain which assets are"
